- Blót

- Patron Gods

Wadrunism is a polytheistic faith from Elseyr. Wadrunism is a primal and ancient religion. A core belief in Wadrunism is the value of Honor and Bravery. It is held in very high regard that those who follow Wadrunism must die fighting, either physically or mentally, so they may enter Valhalla and feast alongside Wadruna.There are multiple temples in the religion dedicated to specific gods or goddesses, as well as holy sites across the entire Commonwealth, it is common for people to pledge themselves to a patron, a god you feel most connected too.
